title: SOC2 solo notes — Noah (working draft)
content:
Purpose: quick lightweight brain dump while I iterate control mapping and evidence matrix for SOC2 readiness. This is a personal scratch — messy, partial, lots of questions.

Summary so far:
- We have most infra controls in place for Dedicated/Hosted, gapier for Private on-prem package (customers ship image).
- Primary gaps to resolve: documented change control (esp for infra-as-code), evidence collection for encryption key rotation, and a simple accepted process for user access reviews (GDrive/Okta lists).
- Need to align with Eng SRE/Platform for automated evidence pulls.

Open questions (need answers before next review):
1) Who is the canonical owner for KMS key rotation evidence for Dedicated? Is it Platform Infra or Cloud Ops? (asked Marcus 2026-02-12, still no reply)
2) For private deployments we rely on customer KMS often — what level of evidence do we provide vs instruct customers to produce? Need policy text.
3) What is the retention policy for audit logs in Hosted API (internal product)? 90 days? 1 year? Confirm with Observability team.
4) Are IAM role changes in prod automatically recorded in a way that meets 'immutable log' expectations (we currently have CloudTrail; need to confirm immutability config).

Quick control mapping draft (super high level — owner / evidence / current status):
- CC-01: Logical access (owner: eng-sre) — evidence: Okta group exports, AD sync logs, joiners/leavers spreadsheet, last access review (2025-11). Status: partial (need automation).
- CC-02: Encryption in transit/at rest (owner: platform-engineering) — evidence: TLS cert inventory, KMS key ARNs, encryption config for S3/GCS. Status: mostly covered for hosted + dedicated; private ambiguous.
- CC-03: Change management (owner: release-engineering) — evidence: PRs with approvals, change calendar, rollback runbooks. Status: spotty for infra IaC changes (we have PRs but approvals not always documented in ticket).
- CC-04: Monitoring/incident response (owner: site-reliability-engineering) — evidence: pagerduty rotations, incident postmortems, metric dashboards. Status: ok but need standardized postmortem templates that include control impact analysis.
- CC-05: Vendor management / third parties (owner: security-and-compliance) — evidence: vendor contracts, security questionnaires, SOC2 reports from vendors. Status: TODO: compile list and freshness dates.

Evidence ideas / where to pull from (operational checklist):
- Okta exports: weekly (scriptable).
- CloudTrail/CloudAudit logs: export to central bucket, TTL 365d? need confirmation.
- GCP/AWS KMS key metadata: lastRotationDate, policy.
- GitHub repo: PR merge history + required review rules screenshot.
- Confluence page: formal change control policy (draft exists at CONF-2345).
- PagerDuty: rotation CSV + recent incidents.
- SRE runbooks: pointer list + link to runbook repo (not all runbooks have metadata tags).

Small experiments to reduce manual work (tech notes):
- Build a lambda (or cloud function) that snapshots Okta group membership weekly and writes JSON into evidence-bucket with timestamped key. Minimal metadata: group, count, export link. PoC: 2 days.
- Use Athena/BigQuery to run quarterly queries on CloudTrail to extract IAM changes and produce digest CSV for auditors. Need to confirm who can run queries (obs team).
- Add a label convention to GitHub PR templates: "SOC2-CHANGE: yes/no" so reviewers tag infra-affecting PRs. Short-term: pilot in infra repos.

Meeting notes (2026-02-18 sync with Leah & Marcus):
- Leah: wants a prioritized list of 10 artifacts we can produce within 2 weeks for the initial auditor intake.
- Marcus: suggested using service-account-level snapshots for key metadata; worries about exposing key ARNs in public artifacts (redact).
- Action: I (Noah) to draft 10-artifact list by 2026-02-23.

10-artifact starter list (deliverable for intake):
1) Okta groups export + last access CSV (redacted)
2) CloudTrail bucket policy + sample logs (last 30 days)
3) TLS cert inventory export (internal)
4) KMS key metadata for hosted/dedicated: last rotation date, key policy (redacted)
5) GitHub org security settings screenshot (required PR rules)
6) Incident postmortem sample (redacted)
7) Change management PR audit for last 30 infra PRs (list)
8) Vendor list + current contracts for top 10 vendors
9) Backup verification runbook + last run output for DB backups
10) Employee access review template + last-reviewed date

Risks & mitigation (short):
- Risk: private/on-prem customer-managed keys introduce variability in evidence. Mitigation: create clear "customer evidence checklist" and customer-facing onboarding doc — ask Solutions Eng to add to onboarding flow.
- Risk: manual processes (ad hoc exports) lead to missed evidence. Mitigation: build 2 automation PoCs (Okta snapshot, CloudTrail query).
- Risk: lack of ownership clarity for certain controls. Mitigation: formalize RACI for top 12 controls; put on PMR agenda.

Next steps (my personal backlog):
- Draft the 10-artifact packet (due 2026-02-23) — in progress.
- Build Okta snapshot PoC (estimate 2d) — schedule with Platform Eng.
- Reach out to Observability (Janine) to confirm log retention policy and export access (target 2026-02-20).
- Prepare short policy blurb for Private deployments (what evidence we can/should provide).

Notes to self: keep this doc messy; move finalized mapping to CONF page later. Mark anything that is customer-facing for review by Leah.

Random ideas for audit day simplification:
- Provide a single archive (zip) with a manifest file mapping each artifact to control IDs and timestamps. Manifest should be machine-readable (JSON) but with human-friendly README.
- Add an "evidence tag" to internal docs/repo READMEs so auditors can be shown a single index quickly.

End of scratch pad. Will iterate after Leah review and PMR.

-- Noah
